title: MERGER
subtitle: 5 of the same rarity become 1 of the next rarity. Common becomes uncommon. The fee is GMT and the five cards are consumed.
insufficientSelected: Insufficient GMT balance for the {{fee}} fee.
empty: No eligible players for this rarity.
rulesCount: Exactly 5 base players of the same rarity.
rulesConsume: The five cards are consumed and leave the inventory.
rulesOnce: The same card cannot enter two fusions.
rulesLineup: They cannot be in the lineup, listed for sale, or retired.
rulesLegendary: Legendary is worth {{value}} GMT. Five legendaries cannot be fused.
rulesCareer: Fusion keeps mining progress and adds the GMT fee to the new athlete's cost basis
